verdict.rationale: Lago documents dunning-adjacent capabilities — a 'Cash Collection' feature to spot overdue/unpaid/partially paid invoices with filters, and an AI 'Dunning Agent' that reads invoice/payment history and chases overdue accounts — but there is no documentation of branded dunning emails, in-app banners, configurable grace periods, or explicit final-state rules (cancel vs unpaid). missing for 10: branded email templates for dunning, in-app banner configuration, grace period settings, explicit cancel-vs-unpaid final-state rule configuration.
